title: Hunt plan
description: A hunt starts from a falsifiable hypothesis. The schema requires a hypothesis, at least one technique, a closure criterion, and the assessment it answers.

assessment_id.description: The assessment that produced this question.

hypothesis.description: If <condition> then <observable>. `huntplan validate` checks the structure and the telemetry; the schema cannot.

closure.description: When the hunt is done, and what 'not found' means.
